intro.en: An uncle and his nephew, a young engineer, talk about looking for a job. Learn new words about work, study and unemployment.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein ek chacha aur unka bhateeja, jo engineer hai, naukri ki talaash par baat karte hain. Kaam, parhai aur berozgari ke naye alfaaz seekhenge.
intro.ar: عَمٌّ وَابْنُ أَخيهِ المُهَنْدِسُ يَتَحَدَّثانِ عَنِ البَحْثِ عَنْ عَمَلٍ. تَتَعَلَّمُ كَلِماتٍ جَديدَةً عَنِ العَمَلِ وَالدِّراسَةِ وَالبِطالَةِ.

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ كانَتْ مُقابَلَةُ العَمَلِ اليَوْمَ يا طارِقُ؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa kānat muqābalatu l-ʿamali l-yawma yā ṭāriq?
dialogue.en: How was the job interview today, Tariq?
dialogue.ur: Tariq, aaj job ka interview kaisa raha?

dialogue.ar: ذَهَبْتُ إِلى المَصْنَعِ وَقَدَّمْتُ شَهاداتي لِلْمُديرِ، لَكِنَّني لَسْتُ مُتَفائِلاً.
dialogue.tr: dhahabtu ilā l-maṣnaʿi waqaddamtu shahādātī lil-mudīr, lākinnanī lastu mutafāʾilan
dialogue.en: I went to the factory and gave my certificates to the manager, but I am not optimistic.
dialogue.ur: Main factory gaya aur manager ko apni sanadein dein, lekin main pur-umeed nahin hoon.

dialogue.ar: وَلِماذا لَسْتَ مُتَفائِلاً؟
dialogue.tr: walimādhā lasta mutafāʾilan?
dialogue.en: And why are you not optimistic?
dialogue.ur: Aur tum pur-umeed kyun nahin ho?

dialogue.ar: يَحْتاجُ المَصْنَعُ إِلى ثَلاثَةِ مُهَنْدِسينَ فَقَطْ، وَقَدْ جاءَ خَمْسونَ شابّاً، وَلَدى بَعْضِهِمْ خِبْرَةٌ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ خِبْرَتي.
dialogue.tr: yaḥtāju l-maṣnaʿu ilā thalāthati muhandisīna faqaṭ, waqad jāʾa khamsūna shābban, waladā baʿḍihim khibratun akbaru min khibratī
dialogue.en: The factory needs only three engineers, and fifty young men came; some of them have more experience than I do.
dialogue.ur: Factory ko sirf teen engineers chahiye, jabke pachaas naujawan aaye, aur kuch ka tajurba mujh se zyada hai.

dialogue.ar: لا تَحْزَنْ يا بُنَيَّ، سَتَجِدُ فُرْصَةً أُخْرى إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ.
dialogue.tr: lā taḥzan yā bunayy, satajidu furṣatan ukhrā in shāʾa llāh
dialogue.en: Do not be sad, my boy; you will find another opportunity, God willing.
dialogue.ur: Gham na karo beta, inshaAllah tumhein doosra mauqa mil jayega.

dialogue.ar: تَخَرَّجْتُ في كُلِّيَّةِ الهَنْدَسَةِ قَبْلَ ثَلاثِ سَنَواتٍ، وَما زِلْتُ أَنْتَظِرُ فُرْصَةَ عَمَلٍ.
dialogue.tr: takharrajtu fī kulliyyati l-handasati qabla thalāthi sanawt, wamā ziltu antaẓiru furṣata ʿamal
dialogue.en: I graduated from the college of engineering three years ago, and I am still waiting for a job opportunity.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe engineering college se nikle teen saal ho gaye, aur main ab bhi naukri ke mauqe ka intezar kar raha hoon.

dialogue.ar: لَيْسَتْ هَذِهِ مُشْكِلَتَكَ وَحْدَكَ، فَالبِطالَةُ تَعُمُّ بِلاداً كَثيرَةً، وَيَشْكو مِنْها شَبابٌ كَثيرونَ.
dialogue.tr: laysat hādhihi mushkilataka waḥdak, fal-biṭālatu taʿummu bilādan kathīra, wayashkū minhā shabābun kathīrūn
dialogue.en: This is not your problem alone; unemployment spreads over many countries, and many young people complain of it.
dialogue.ur: Ye sirf tumhara masla nahin; berozgari bohat se mulkon mein phaili hui hai aur bohat se naujawan us se pareshan hain.

dialogue.ar: أُريدُ أَنْ أُساعِدَ والِدَيَّ وَأُفَكِّرُ في الزَّواجِ، وَلا أَسْتَطيعُ ذَلِكَ بِلا عَمَلٍ.
dialogue.tr: urīdu an usāʿida wālidayya waʾufakkiru fī z-zawj, walā astaṭīʿu dhālika bilā ʿamal
dialogue.en: I want to help my parents and I think about marriage, and I cannot do that without work.
dialogue.ur: Main apne walidain ki madad karna chahta hoon aur shaadi ke baare mein sochta hoon, lekin kaam ke baghair ye mumkin nahin.

dialogue.ar: تَقولُ الحُكومَةُ إِنَّها سَتَفْتَحُ مَشاريعَ جَديدَةً وَسَتُوَفِّرُ فُرَصَ عَمَلٍ لِلشَّبابِ.
dialogue.tr: taqūlu l-ḥukūmatu innahā sataftaḥu mashārīʿa jadīdatan wasatuwaffiru furaṣa ʿamalin lish-shabāb
dialogue.en: The government says it will open new projects and provide job opportunities for young people.
dialogue.ur: Hukumat kehti hai ke wo naye mansoobe shuru karegi aur naujawanon ke liye naukriyon ke mauqe paida karegi.

dialogue.ar: أَنْتَظِرُ تِلْكَ الفُرَصَ يا عَمّي، لَكِنَّ الانْتِظارَ طَويلٌ.
dialogue.tr: antaẓiru tilka l-furaṣa yā ʿammī, lākin al-ntiẓāra ṭawīl
dialogue.en: I am waiting for those opportunities, uncle, but the waiting is long.
dialogue.ur: Chacha jaan, main un mauqon ka intezar kar raha hoon, lekin intezar bohat lamba hai.

dialogue.ar: اِصْبِرْ يا طارِقُ وَكُنْ مُتَفائِلاً، فَالخَيْرُ قَريبٌ.
dialogue.tr: iṣbir yā ṭāriqu wakun mutafāʾilan, fal-khayru qarīb
dialogue.en: Be patient, Tariq, and be optimistic; good is near.
dialogue.ur: Sabr karo Tariq aur pur-umeed raho, bhalai qareeb hai.

vocab.ur: usne (kisi idare se) tahseel mukammal ki

q.en: The factory needs three engineers. How many young men came?
q.ur: Factory ko teen engineers chahiye. Kitne naujawan aaye?
q.ar: يَحْتاجُ المَصْنَعُ إِلى ثَلاثَةِ مُهَنْدِسينَ. فَكَمْ شابّاً جاءَ؟

intro.en: Hamzat al-waṣl is pronounced at the start of speech and is NOT pronounced in the middle. Example: «اِسْمُكَ عَلِيّ» (pronounced) but «ما اسْمُكَ؟» (not pronounced).
intro.ur: Hamzat al-wasl bolne ki shuruaat mein parhi jati hai, darmiyan mein nahin parhi jati. Misal: «اِسْمُكَ عَلِيّ» (parhi gayi) lekin «ما اسْمُكَ؟» (nahin parhi gayi).
intro.ar: هَمْزَةُ الوَصْلِ تُنْطَقُ في بِدايَةِ الكَلامِ وَلا تُنْطَقُ في وَسَطِهِ. مِثْلُ: «اِسْمُكَ عَلِيّ» وَ«ما اسْمُكَ؟».

q.ur: Hamzat al-wasl kab parhi jati hai?

q.en: In which sentence is it NOT pronounced?
q.ur: Kis jumle mein nahin parhi jati?
q.ar: في أَيِّ جُمْلَةٍ لا تُنْطَقُ هَمْزَةُ الوَصْلِ؟

q.en: In which sentence is it pronounced?
q.ur: Kis jumle mein parhi jati hai?
q.ar: في أَيِّ جُمْلَةٍ تُنْطَقُ هَمْزَةُ الوَصْلِ؟

q.en: Which word starts with hamzat al-waṣl?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz hamzat al-wasl se shuru hota hai?

intro.en: Negation is the opposite of affirmation. Its tools are: ما، لا، لَنْ، لَمْ، لَيْسَ. Example: «يَصومُ سَعيدٌ اليَوْمَ» becomes «لَنْ يَصومَ سَعيدٌ اليَوْمَ».
intro.ur: Nafi, isbat ka ulta hai. Iske alfaaz hain: ما، لا، لَنْ، لَمْ، لَيْسَ. Misal: «يَصومُ سَعيدٌ اليَوْمَ» se «لَنْ يَصومَ سَعيدٌ اليَوْمَ» bana.
intro.ar: النَّفْيُ عَكْسُ الإِثْباتِ، وَأَدَواتُهُ: ما، لا، لَنْ، لَمْ، لَيْسَ. مِثالٌ: «يَصومُ سَعيدٌ اليَوْمَ» يُصْبِحُ «لَنْ يَصومَ سَعيدٌ اليَوْمَ».

q.en: Which is NOT a negation tool?
q.ur: Inmein se nafi ka lafz kaun sa nahin hai?

q.en: Which tool is used for the future (will not)?
q.ur: Mustaqbil (nahin karega) ke liye kaun sa lafz?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةٍ تَنْفي الفِعْلَ في المُسْتَقْبَلِ؟

intro.en: Practise the negation tools and talk about jobs: engineer, doctor, teacher, pilot and pharmacist. Ask a friend: «هَلْ تُفَضِّلُ أَنْ تَكونَ مُهَنْدِساً؟ وَلِماذا؟»
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein nafi ki mashq karenge aur peshon ki baat karenge: engineer, doctor, teacher, pilot aur pharmacist. Dost se poochein: «هَلْ تُفَضِّلُ أَنْ تَكونَ مُهَنْدِساً؟ وَلِماذا؟»
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى أَدَواتِ النَّفْيِ وَتَحَدَّثْ عَنِ المِهَنِ: المُهَنْدِسُ وَالطَّبيبُ وَالمُعَلِّمُ وَالطَّيّارُ وَالصَّيْدَلِيُّ. اِسْأَلْ صَديقَكَ: «هَلْ تُفَضِّلُ أَنْ تَكونَ مُهَنْدِساً؟ وَلِماذا؟»

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني مَنْ يَبيعُ الأَدْوِيَةَ وَيُحَضِّرُها؟

intro.en: A reading passage about three different opinions on whether a woman should work outside her home. The text only reports what each group says. Notice how it uses «فَريق» (group) and «يَرى» (he sees / thinks).
intro.ur: Ek parhne ka matn jis mein teen mukhtalif raaye bayan hui hain ke aurat ghar se bahar kaam kare ya nahin. Matn sirf har giroh ki baat batata hai. Dhyan dein: «فَريق» (giroh) aur «يَرى» (woh samajhta hai).
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلْقِراءَةِ فيهِ ثَلاثَةُ آراءٍ في عَمَلِ المَرْأَةِ خارِجَ بَيْتِها. يَنْقُلُ النَّصُّ ما يَقولُهُ كُلُّ فَريقٍ فَقَط. اِنْتَبِهْ إِلى كَلِمَةِ «فَريق» وَالفِعْلِ «يَرى».

dialogue.ar: يَخْتَلِفُ النّاسُ اليَوْمَ في عَمَلِ المَرْأَةِ، وَيَنْقَسِمونَ في ذَلِكَ إِلى ثَلاثَةِ فِرَقٍ.
dialogue.tr: yakhtalifu n-nāsu l-yawma fī ʿamali l-marʾa, wayanqasimūna fī dhālika ilā thalāthati firaq
dialogue.en: People today differ about women's work, and they split into three groups.
dialogue.ur: Aaj log aurat ke kaam ke baare mein ikhtilaf karte hain aur teen giroho mein bat jate hain.

dialogue.ar: يَرى الفَريقُ الأَوَّلُ أَنَّ العَمَلَ خارِجَ البَيْتِ يَجِبُ أَنْ يَكونَ مَفْتوحاً لِلْمَرْأَةِ كَما هُوَ لِلرَّجُلِ.
dialogue.tr: yarā l-farīqu l-awwalu anna al-ʿamala khārija l-bayti yajibu an yakūna maftūḥan lil-marʾati kamā huwa lir-rajul
dialogue.en: The first group sees that work outside the home should be open to women just as it is to men.
dialogue.ur: Pehla giroh samajhta hai ke ghar se bahar kaam ka darwaza aurat ke liye bhi khula hona chahiye, jaise mard ke liye hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَقولونَ: تُشَكِّلُ المَرْأَةُ نِصْفَ المُجْتَمَعِ، وَالمُجْتَمَعُ يَحْتاجُ إِلى عَمَلِها، فَلا يَصِحُّ أَنْ تَبْقى بَعيدَةً عَنِ الوَظائِفِ.
dialogue.tr: wayaqūlūn tushakkilu l-marʾatu niṣfa l-mujtamaʿ, wal-mujtamaʿu yaḥtāju ilā ʿamalihā, falā yaṣiḥḥu an tabqā baʿīdatan ʿani l-waẓāʾif
dialogue.en: They say: women make up half of society, and society needs her work, so it is not right for her to stay away from jobs.
dialogue.ur: Wo kehte hain: aurat muashre ka aadha hissa hai, muashra uske kaam ka mohtaaj hai, isliye naukriyon se door rehna theek nahin.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا الفَريقُ الثّاني فَيَرى أَنَّ البَيْتَ هُوَ مَكانُ عَمَلِ المَرْأَةِ الأَوَّلُ؛ فَهِيَ تَغْسِلُ وَتُنَظِّفُ وَتُعِدُّ الطَّعامَ، وَتُرَبّي أَبْناءَها.
dialogue.tr: ammā l-farīqu th-thānī fayarā anna al-bayta huwa makānu ʿamali l-marʾati l-awwal fahiya taghsilu watunaẓẓifu watuʿiddu aṭ-ṭaʿām, waturabbī abnāʾahā
dialogue.en: As for the second group, it sees that the home is a woman's first place of work: she washes, cleans, prepares food and raises her children.
dialogue.ur: Doosra giroh samajhta hai ke ghar aurat ke kaam ki pehli jagah hai: wo dhoti hai, safai karti hai, khana banati hai aur apne bachchon ki tarbiyat karti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَخافُ هَذا الفَريقُ أَنْ يُؤَدِّيَ خُروجُها إِلى ضَعْفِ الأُسْرَةِ وَقِلَّةِ الاهْتِمامِ بِالصِّغارِ.
dialogue.tr: wayakhāfu hādhā l-farīqu an yuʾaddiya khurūjuhā ilā ḍaʿfi l-usrati waqillati l-htimāmi biṣ-ṣighār
dialogue.en: This group fears that her going out may lead to a weaker family and less care for the little ones.
dialogue.ur: Ye giroh darta hai ke aurat ke bahar jaane se khandaan kamzor ho aur chhote bachchon ki dekh-bhaal kam ho jaye.

dialogue.ar: وَيَرى الفَريقُ الثّالِثُ أَنَّ العَمَلَ حَقٌّ لِلْمَرْأَةِ بِشَرْطٍ: أَنْ يَكونَ العَمَلُ مُناسِباً لَها، وَأَنْ تَبْقى أُسْرَتُها في أَمانٍ.
dialogue.tr: wayarā l-farīqu th-thālithu anna al-ʿamala ḥaqqun lil-marʾati bisharṭ an yakūna l-ʿamalu munāsiban lahā, waʾan tabqā usratuhā fī amān
dialogue.en: The third group sees that work is a right of the woman on a condition: that the work suits her and that her family stays safe.
dialogue.ur: Teesra giroh samajhta hai ke kaam aurat ka haq hai ek shart par: kaam uske munasib ho aur uska khandaan mehfooz rahe.

dialogue.ar: فَتَعْمَلُ المَرْأَةُ مُمَرِّضَةً أَوْ مُعَلِّمَةً أَوْ طَبيبَةً في مَكانٍ يُناسِبُها.
dialogue.tr: fataʿmalu l-marʾatu mumarriḍatan aw muʿallimatan aw ṭabībatan fī makānin yunāsibuhā
dialogue.en: So a woman works as a nurse, a teacher or a doctor in a place that suits her.
dialogue.ur: Yun aurat nurse, ustaani ya doctor ban kar aisi jagah kaam karti hai jo uske munasib ho.

dialogue.ar: وَهَكَذا يَنْظُرُ كُلُّ فَريقٍ إِلى المَوْضوعِ مِنْ جانِبٍ، وَالحِوارُ بَيْنَهُمْ ما زالَ مَفْتوحاً.
dialogue.tr: wahakadhā yanẓuru kullu farīqin ilā l-mawḍūʿi min jānib, wal-ḥiwru baynahum mā zāla maftūḥan
dialogue.en: In this way each group looks at the matter from one side, and the discussion between them is still open.
dialogue.ur: Is tarah har giroh mamle ko ek pehlu se dekhta hai, aur unke darmiyan baat-cheet ab bhi jaari hai.

q.en: How many groups does the text mention?
The first group says a woman is:
The third group says a woman may work if:
q.ur: Teesre giroh ke mutabiq aurat kaam kar sakti hai agar:
q.ar: يَرى الفَريقُ الثّالِثُ أَنَّ المَرْأَةَ تَعْمَلُ إِذا:

intro.en: A verb is of two kinds. Intransitive (لازِم) does not need an object: «يَفْرَحُ الطُّلابُ بِالنَّجاحِ». Transitive (مُتَعَدٍّ) needs an object: «تَغْسِلُ المَرْأَةُ المَلابِسَ» (she washes what? the clothes).
intro.ur: Fe'l ki do qismein hain. Laazim ko maful bih nahin chahiye: «يَفْرَحُ الطُّلابُ بِالنَّجاحِ». Muta'addi ko maful bih chahiye: «تَغْسِلُ المَرْأَةُ المَلابِسَ» (kya dhoti hai? kapde).
intro.ar: الفِعْلُ نَوْعانِ: لازِمٌ لا يَحْتاجُ إِلى مَفْعولٍ بِهِ مِثْلُ «يَفْرَحُ الطُّلابُ بِالنَّجاحِ»، وَمُتَعَدٍّ يَحْتاجُ إِلى مَفْعولٍ بِهِ مِثْلُ «تَغْسِلُ المَرْأَةُ المَلابِسَ».

q.en: Which sentence has a transitive verb?
q.ur: Kis jumle mein muta'addi fe'l hai?

q.en: Which sentence has an intransitive verb?
q.ur: Kis jumle mein laazim fe'l hai?

options: A verb that does not need an object
A verb that needs an object
options_ar: فِعْلٌ لا يَحْتاجُ إِلى مَفْعولٍ بِهِ

q.en: In «تُديرُ الزَّوْجَةُ البَيْتَ» what is the object?
q.ur: «تُديرُ الزَّوْجَةُ البَيْتَ» mein maful bih kaun hai?
q.ar: ما المَفْعولُ بِهِ في جُمْلَةِ «تُديرُ الزَّوْجَةُ البَيْتَ»؟

intro.en: Two friends, Karim and Hisham, talk about Hisham travelling abroad to work and how to keep one's religion, culture and language.
intro.ur: Do dost, Karim aur Hisham, Hisham ke kaam ke liye pardes jaane par baat karte hain aur is par ke apna deen, saqafat aur zubaan kaise mehfooz rakhein.
intro.ar: صَديقانِ، كَريمٌ وَهِشامٌ، يَتَحَدَّثانِ عَنْ سَفَرِ هِشامٍ لِلْعَمَلِ خارِجَ بَلَدِهِ وَكَيْفَ يُحافِظُ الإِنْسانُ عَلى دينِهِ وَثَقافَتِهِ وَلُغَتِهِ.

dialogue.ar: سَمِعْتُ أَنَّكَ تُفَكِّرُ في الاغْتِرابِ يا هِشامُ.
dialogue.tr: samiʿtu annaka tufakkiru fī l-ghtirābi yā hishām
dialogue.en: I heard that you are thinking of living abroad, Hisham.
dialogue.ur: Hisham, maine suna hai ke tum pardes jaane ka soch rahe ho.

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، جاءَتْني دَعْوَةٌ لِلْعَمَلِ في دَوْلَةٍ بَعيدَةٍ، وَالرّاتِبُ هُناكَ أَعْلى بِكَثيرٍ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, jāʾatnī daʿwatun lil-ʿamali fī dawlatin baʿīda, war-rātibu hunāka aʿlā bikathīr
dialogue.en: Yes, I received an invitation to work in a distant country, and the salary there is much higher.
dialogue.ur: Haan, mujhe ek door ke mulk mein kaam ki dawat mili hai, aur wahan tankhwah bohat zyada hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلَكِنَّ الوَطَنَ يَحْتاجُ إِلى أَبْنائِهِ، وَعَمَلُكَ هُنا لَيْسَ سَيِّئاً.
dialogue.tr: walakinna al-waṭana yaḥtāju ilā abnāʾih, waʿamaluka hunā laysa sayyiʾan
dialogue.en: But the homeland needs its sons, and your work here is not bad.
dialogue.ur: Lekin watan ko apne beton ki zaroorat hai, aur yahan tumhara kaam bura nahin.

dialogue.ar: أَعْرِفُ ذَلِكَ، لَكِنَّني أُريدُ حَياةً أَسْهَلَ لِأُسْرَتي.
dialogue.tr: aʿrifu dhālika, lākinnanī urīdu ḥaytan ashala liʾusratī
dialogue.en: I know that, but I want an easier life for my family.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe pata hai, lekin main apne ghar walon ke liye aasaan zindagi chahta hoon.

dialogue.ar: وَالرِّزْقُ الحَلالُ يُطْلَبُ في الأَرْضِ كُلِّها. قالَ اللهُ تَعالى: هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَامْشُوا فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا مِن رِّزْقِهِ  وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ.
dialogue.tr: war-rizqu l-ḥalālu yuṭlabu fī l-arḍi kullihā qāla llāh taʿālā huwa lladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa dhalūlan fāmshū fī manākibihā wakulū min rizqihi waʾilayhi n-nushūr
dialogue.en: Lawful provision is sought across the whole earth. Allah the Most High said: "It is He who made the earth tame for you, so walk in its tracts and eat of His provision, and to Him is the resurrection."
dialogue.ur: Halal rizq poori zameen mein talash kiya jata hai. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "Wohi hai jis ne zameen ko tumhare liye ta'abe kar diya, to uske raston mein chalo aur uske rizq mein se khao, aur usi ki taraf uthna hai."

dialogue.ar: صَدَقَ اللهُ تَعالى. وَلَكِنْ مَنْ سَيَبْقى قَريباً مِنْ والِدَيْكَ؟
dialogue.tr: ṣadaqa llāh taʿālā walakin man sayabqā qarīban min wālidayk?
dialogue.en: Allah the Most High spoke the truth. But who will stay close to your parents?
dialogue.ur: Allah Ta'ala ne sach farmaya. Lekin tumhare walidain ke qareeb kaun rahega?

dialogue.ar: سَآخُذُ زَوْجَتي وَأَوْلادي مَعي، وَنَزورُ والِدَيَّ كُلَّ صَيْفٍ.
dialogue.tr: saʾākhudhu zawjatī waʾawlādī maʿī, wanazūru wālidayya kulla ṣayf
dialogue.en: I will take my wife and children with me, and we will visit my parents every summer.
dialogue.ur: Main biwi bachchon ko saath le jaunga, aur har garmi mein walidain se milne aayenge.

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ سَتُحافِظونَ عَلى دينِكُمْ وَلُغَتِكُمْ وَثَقافَتِكُمْ في بَلَدٍ غَريبٍ؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa satuḥāfiẓūna ʿalā dīnikum walughatikum wathaqāfatikum fī baladin gharīb?
dialogue.en: How will you keep your religion, language and culture in a strange country?
dialogue.ur: Ek ajnabi mulk mein aap apna deen, zubaan aur saqafat kaise mehfooz rakhenge?

dialogue.ar: سَنَخْتارُ حَيّاً فيهِ مَسْجِدٌ وَمَدْرَسَةٌ عَرَبِيَّةٌ، وَلَنْ نَتْرُكَ لُغَتَنا.
dialogue.tr: sanakhtāru ḥayyan fīhi masjidun wamadrasatun ʿarabiyya, walan natruka lughatanā
dialogue.en: We will choose a neighbourhood with a mosque and an Arabic school, and we will never leave our language.
dialogue.ur: Hum aisa mohalla chunenge jahan masjid aur Arabi school ho, aur hum apni zubaan hargiz nahin chhodenge.

dialogue.ar: هَذِهِ نَصيحَتي: أَرْجو أَنْ تَسْأَلَ أَهْلَ الخِبْرَةِ هُناكَ قَبْلَ السَّفَرِ.
dialogue.tr: hādhihi naṣīḥatī arjū an tasʾala ahla l-khibrati hunāka qabla s-safar
dialogue.en: This is my advice: I hope you ask people of experience there before travelling.
dialogue.ur: Meri nasihat ye hai: umeed hai ke safar se pehle wahan ke tajurba-kar logon se poochh lo.

dialogue.ar: شُكْراً يا كَريمُ عَلى هَذِهِ النَّصيحَةِ، سَأَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ.
dialogue.tr: shukran yā karīmu ʿalā hādhihi n-naṣīḥa, saʾafʿalu dhālika
dialogue.en: Thank you, Karim, for this advice; I will do that.
dialogue.ur: Karim, is nasihat ka shukriya, main aisa hi karunga.

dialogue.ar: وَهَلْ وافَقَ أَهْلُ زَوْجَتِكَ عَلى سَفَرِكُمْ؟
dialogue.tr: wahal wāfaqa ahlu zawjatika ʿalā safarikum?
dialogue.en: And did your wife's family agree to your travelling?
dialogue.ur: Aur kya aapki biwi ke ghar walon ne aapke safar par razamandi di?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، وافَقوا بَعْدَ نِقاشٍ طَويلٍ، وَدَعَوْا لَنا بِالتَّوْفيقِ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, wāfaqū baʿda niqāshin ṭawīl, wadaʿaw lanā bit-tawfīq
dialogue.en: Yes, they agreed after a long discussion and prayed for our success.
dialogue.ur: Haan, lambi baat-cheet ke baad wo razi ho gaye aur hamare liye kamyabi ki dua ki.

dialogue.ar: كَمْ سَنَةً سَتُقيمونَ هُناكَ؟
dialogue.tr: kam sanatan satuqīmūna hunāk?
dialogue.en: How many years will you stay there?
dialogue.ur: Aap wahan kitne saal rahenge?

dialogue.ar: نُقيمُ هُناكَ ثَلاثَ سَنَواتٍ، وَبَعْدَها نَعودُ إِلى وَطَنِنا بِإِذْنِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: nuqīmu hunāka thalātha sanawt, wabaʿdahā naʿūdu ilā waṭaninā biʾidhni llāh
dialogue.en: We will stay there three years, and then return to our homeland, by Allah's leave.
dialogue.ur: Hum wahan teen saal rahenge, phir Allah ke izn se apne watan laut aayenge.

dialogue.ar: أَرْجو لَكُمْ سَفَراً سالِماً وَعَوْدَةً قَريبَةً.
dialogue.tr: arjū lakum safaran sāliman waʿawdatan qarība
dialogue.en: I wish you a safe journey and a quick return.
dialogue.ur: Main aap ke liye mehfooz safar aur jald wapsi ki dua karta hoon.

dialogue.ar: بارَكَ اللهُ فيكَ.
dialogue.tr: bāraka llāh fīk
dialogue.en: May Allah bless you.
dialogue.ur: Allah tumhein barkat de.

q.en: How long will Hisham stay abroad?
q.ur: Hisham pardes mein kitni muddat rahega?
Karim, Hisham se kis ke baare mein poochhta hai?

options: Keeping religion, language and culture abroad
options_ar: المُحافَظَةِ عَلى الدّينِ وَاللُّغَةِ وَالثَّقافَةِ في الغُرْبَةِ

intro.en: Pointing words: for near: هَذا (this, masculine), هَذِهِ (this, feminine), هُنا (here), هَذانِ، هاتانِ (two), هَؤُلاءِ (these). For far: ذَلِكَ، تِلْكَ، هُناكَ.
intro.ur: Ishara ke alfaaz: qareeb ke liye: هَذا (yeh, muzakkar), هَذِهِ (yeh, muannas), هُنا (yahan), هَذانِ، هاتانِ (do ke liye), هَؤُلاءِ (yeh sab). Door ke liye: ذَلِكَ، تِلْكَ، هُناكَ.
intro.ar: أَسْماءُ الإِشارَةِ لِلْقَريبِ: هَذا، هَذِهِ، هُنا، هَذانِ، هاتانِ، هَؤُلاءِ. وَلِلْبَعيدِ: ذَلِكَ، تِلْكَ، هُناكَ.

q.en: "This" for a masculine singular noun near you:
q.ur: Qareeb ke muzakkar wahid ke liye "yeh":
q.ar: ما اسْمُ الإِشارَةِ لِلْمُفْرَدِ المُذَكَّرِ القَريبِ؟

q.en: "That" for a masculine noun far away:
q.ar: ما اسْمُ الإِشارَةِ لِلْمُفْرَدِ المُذَكَّرِ البَعيدِ؟

q.en: "These" (for a group of men and women):
q.ar: ما اسْمُ الإِشارَةِ لِجَماعَةِ الرِّجالِ وَالنِّساءِ؟

q.en: Choose: «.....طالِبانِ في الثّانَوِيَّةِ» (two male students, near)
q.ar: اِخْتَرْ: «.....طالِبانِ في الثّانَوِيَّةِ» (إِشارَةٌ إِلى اثْنَيْنِ قَريبَيْنِ).

intro.en: Listen to a dialogue about a married couple who work as doctors, then discuss the topic of working abroad with your classmate.
intro.ur: Ek shaadi-shuda jode ki baat sunein jo doctor hain, phir apne sathi ke saath pardes mein kaam ke mauzu par baat karein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى حِوارٍ عَنْ زَوْجَيْنِ يَعْمَلانِ طَبيبَيْنِ، ثُمَّ تَحَدَّثْ مَعْ زَميلِكَ عَنِ العَمَلِ خارِجَ الوَطَنِ.

intro.en: A reading about the value of work in Islam, with two sayings of the Prophet ﷺ and a story about a poor young man who learned to earn with his own hands. The text quotes the Prophet ﷺ; read it with respect.
intro.ur: Kaam ki ahmiyat par ek matn, jis mein Nabi ﷺ ke do farameen hain aur ek ghareeb naujawan ka qissa hai jis ne apne haathon se kamana seekha. Matn mein Nabi ﷺ ke farameen hain; adab ke saath parhein.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنْ قيمَةِ العَمَلِ في الإِسْلامِ، فيهِ حَديثانِ لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَقِصَّةُ شابٍّ فَقيرٍ تَعَلَّمَ الكَسْبَ بِيَدِهِ. يَنْقُلُ النَّصُّ كَلامَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَاقْرَأْهُ بِاحْتِرامٍ.

dialogue.ar: العَمَلُ نِعْمَةٌ مِنَ اللهِ، وَالصِّحَّةُ نِعْمَةٌ أُخْرى، وَمَنْ فَقَدَ صِحَّتَهُ بِالمَرَضِ تَعِبَ في عَمَلِهِ.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿamalu niʿmatun mina llāh, waṣ-ṣiḥatu niʿmatun ukhrā, waman faqada ṣiḥḥatahu bil-maraḍi taʿiba fī ʿamalih
dialogue.en: Work is a blessing from Allah, and health is another blessing; whoever loses his health through illness struggles in his work.
dialogue.ur: Kaam Allah ki nematon mein se ek nemat hai, aur sehat bhi ek nemat hai; jo bimari se sehat kho de, wo apne kaam mein mushkil mehsoos karta hai.

dialogue.ar: لَكِنَّ بَعْضَ القادِرينَ عَلى العَمَلِ يَجْلِسونَ في بُيوتِهِمْ، يَعْتَمِدونَ عَلى النّاسِ أَوْ يَتَسَوَّلونَ عِنْدَ أَبْوابِ المَساجِدِ.
dialogue.tr: lākin baʿḍa l-qādirīna ʿalā l-ʿamali yajlisūna fī buywtihim, yaʿtamidūna ʿalā n-nāsi aw yatasawwalūna ʿinda abwbi l-masājid
dialogue.en: But some who are able to work sit at home, depending on people or begging at the doors of mosques.
dialogue.ur: Lekin kuch log kaam kar sakte hain phir bhi ghar baithe rehte hain, doosron par bharosa karte hain ya masjidon ke darwazon par bheek mangte hain.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: «ما أَكَلَ أَحَدٌ طَعاماً قَطُّ خَيْراً مِنْ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مِنْ عَمَلِ يَدِهِ، وَإِنَّ نَبِيَّ اللهِ داوُدَ كانَ يَأْكُلُ مِنْ عَمَلِ يَدِهِ».
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūlu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam: mā akala aḥadun ṭaʿāman qaṭṭu khayran min an yaʾkula min ʿamali yadih, wa inna nabiyya llāhi Dāwūda kāna yaʾkulu min ʿamali yadih
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ said: "No one has ever eaten better food than that which he eats from the work of his own hand, and the Prophet of Allah Dawud used to eat from the work of his hand."
dialogue.ur: Rasoolullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Kisi ne kabhi is se behtar khana nahin khaya ke woh apne haath ki kamai se khaye, aur Allah ke nabi Dawud (alaihis salam) apne haath ki kamai se khate the."

dialogue.ar: وَقالَ: «لَأَنْ يَأْخُذَ أَحَدُكُمْ حَبْلَهُ، ثُمَّ يَغْدُوَ إِلى الجَبَلِ، فَيَحْتَطِبَ، فَيَبيعَ، فَيَأْكُلَ، وَيَتَصَدَّقَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ يَسْأَلَ النّاسَ».
dialogue.tr: wa qāla: la-an yaʾkhudha aḥadukum ḥablahu, thumma yaghduwa ilā l-jabal, fa-yaḥtaṭiba, fa-yabīʿa, fa-yaʾkula, wa yataṣaddaqa khayrun min an yasʾala n-nās
dialogue.en: And he said: "That one of you takes his rope, goes to the mountain, gathers wood, sells it, eats and gives charity, is better than asking people."
dialogue.ur: Aur farmaya: "Tum mein se koi apni rassi le, pahaar ki taraf jaye, lakdiyan chune, bech kar khaye aur sadqa de, yeh is se behtar hai ke logon se maange."

dialogue.ar: وَيُحْكى أَنَّ شابّاً فَقيراً اسْمُهُ مَسْعودٌ كانَ يَسْأَلُ النّاسَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ في سوقِ القَرْيَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wayuḥkā anna shābban faqīran smuhu masʿūdun kāna yasʾalu n-nāsa kulla yawmin fī sūqi l-qarya
dialogue.en: It is told that a poor young man named Masud used to ask people for money every day in the village market.
dialogue.ur: Kaha jata hai ke Masud naam ka ek ghareeb naujawan roz gaon ke bazaar mein logon se mangta tha.

dialogue.ar: فَقالَ لَهُ تاجِرٌ غَنِيٌّ طَيِّبُ القَلْبِ: يا بُنَيَّ، أَنْتَ قَوِيٌّ وَصِحَّتُكَ جَيِّدَةٌ، فَلِماذا لا تَعْمَلُ؟
dialogue.tr: faqāla lahu tājirun ghaniyyun ṭayyibu l-qalb yā bunayy, anta qawiyyun waṣiḥḥatuka jayyida, falimādhā lā taʿmal?
dialogue.en: A rich, kind-hearted merchant said to him: My boy, you are strong and your health is good, so why do you not work?
dialogue.ur: Ek maaldar naram-dil tajir ne usse kaha: Beta, tum tawana ho aur tumhari sehat achhi hai, phir kaam kyun nahin karte?

dialogue.ar: قالَ مَسْعودٌ: لا أَمْلِكُ شَيْئاً أَعْمَلُ بِهِ. فَأَعْطاهُ التّاجِرُ دِرْهَمَيْنِ وَقالَ: اِشْتَرِ بِهِما قَدُّوماً.
dialogue.tr: qāla masʿūd lā amliku shayʾan aʿmalu bih faʾaʿṭāhu t-tājiru dirhamayni waqāl ishtari bihimā qaddūman
dialogue.en: Masud said: I own nothing to work with. So the merchant gave him two dirhams and said: Buy an axe with them.
dialogue.ur: Masud ne kaha: Mere paas koi cheez nahin jis se kaam karun. Tajir ne use do dirham diye aur kaha: In se kulhari khareed lo.

dialogue.ar: فَاشْتَرى مَسْعودٌ قَدُّوماً، وَذَهَبَ إِلى الجَبَلِ يَحْتَطِبُ، ثُمَّ حَمَلَ الحَطَبَ إِلى السّوقِ وَباعَهُ.
dialogue.tr: fāshtarā masʿūdun qaddūman, wadhahaba ilā l-jabali yaḥtaṭib, thumma ḥamala l-ḥaṭaba ilā s-sūqi wabāʿah
dialogue.en: Masud bought an axe and went to the mountain to gather wood, then carried the wood to the market and sold it.
dialogue.ur: Masud ne kulhari khareedi, pahar par lakriyan kaatne gaya, phir lakriyan bazaar le ja kar bech di.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ أُسْبوعٍ أَتى إِلى التّاجِرِ وَقالَ: شُكْراً لَكَ، لَمْ أَعُدْ أَسْأَلُ أَحَداً.
dialogue.tr: wabaʿda usbūʿin atā ilā t-tājiri waqāl shukran lak, lam aʿud asʾalu aḥadan
dialogue.en: After a week he came to the merchant and said: Thank you, I no longer ask anyone.
dialogue.ur: Ek hafte baad wo tajir ke paas aaya aur bola: Aap ka shukriya, ab main kisi se nahin mangta.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ سَنَةٍ صارَ مَسْعودٌ يَتَصَدَّقُ بِجُزْءٍ مِنْ رِبْحِهِ عَلى الفُقَراءِ، وَلَمْ يَعُدْ يَخافُ أَنْ يُعْطِيَهُ النّاسُ أَوْ يَمْنَعوهُ.
dialogue.tr: wabaʿda sanatin ṣāra masʿūdun yataṣaddaqu bijuzʾin min ribḥihi ʿalā l-fuqarāʾ, walam yaʿud yakhāfu an yuʿṭiyahu n-nāsu aw yamnaʿūh
dialogue.en: After a year Masud began to give part of his profit as charity to the poor, and he no longer feared whether people would give him or refuse him.
dialogue.ur: Ek saal baad Masud apne nafe ka ek hissa ghareebon par sadqa karne laga, aur use ab is ka dar na raha ke log use dein ya mana kar dein.

dialogue.ar: وَهَكَذا تَعَلَّمَ مَسْعودٌ أَنَّ اليَدَ العامِلَةَ خَيْرٌ مِنَ اليَدِ السّائِلَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wahakadhā taʿallama masʿūdun anna al-yada l-ʿāmilata khayrun mina l-yadi s-sāʾila
dialogue.en: In this way Masud learned that the working hand is better than the begging hand.
dialogue.ur: Is tarah Masud ne seekha ke mehnat karne wala haath mangne wale haath se behtar hai.

q.en: What is work, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq kaam kya hai?

q.en: What did Masud buy with the merchant's money?
q.ur: Masud ne tajir ke paison se kya khareeda?

intro.en: To make the sound feminine plural, add «ـات» (alif + ta) to the end of the singular: جامِعَة → جامِعات، حُكومَة → حُكوماتٌ، خِبْرَة → خِبْراتٌ. The «ة» drops away.
intro.ur: Jam' muannas salim banane ke liye wahid ke aakhir mein «ـات» (alif + ta) lagate hain: جامِعَة → جامِعات، حُكومَة → حُكوماتٌ، خِبْرَة → خِبْراتٌ. «ة» hat jati hai.
intro.ar: لِجَمْعِ المُؤَنَّثِ السّالِمِ نُضيفُ «ـات» إِلى آخِرِ المُفْرَدِ وَتَسْقُطُ التّاءُ المَرْبوطَةُ: جامِعَة ← جامِعات، حُكومَة ← حُكوماتٌ، خِبْرَة ← خِبْراتٌ.

q.en: What is added to make the sound feminine plural?
q.ur: Jam' muannas salim ke liye kya lagate hain?
q.ar: ما الَّذي يُضافُ لِتَكْوينِ جَمْعِ المُؤَنَّثِ السّالِمِ؟

intro.en: Practise writing short sentences about people at work: a beggar, a man who eats from his own labour, a young man who depends on his father, the opinions about women working, and the jobs of a doctor, a teacher and a farmer.
intro.ur: Chhote jumle likhne ki mashq: bheek mangne wala, apni mehnat ki kamai khane wala, apne walid par bharosa karne wala naujawan, aurat ke kaam par raayein, aur doctor, ustaad aur kisan ka kaam.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى كِتابَةِ جُمَلٍ قَصيرَةٍ عَنِ النّاسِ في العَمَلِ: المُتَسَوِّلُ، وَمَنْ يَأْكُلُ مِنْ عَمَلِ يَدِهِ، وَالشّابُّ المُعْتَمِدُ عَلى أَبيهِ، وَآراءُ النّاسِ في عَمَلِ المَرْأَةِ، وَمِهَنُ الطَّبيبِ وَالمُدَرِّسِ وَالفَلّاحِ.

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني مَنْ يَزْرَعُ الأَرْضَ؟

options: He took care of his children

intro.en: Write in Naskh script. Spelling rule: the hamza of «اِبْن» and «اِبْنَة» is dropped when they come between two names, for example: «سَعْدُ بْنُ مُعاذٍ».
intro.ur: Naskh khat mein likhein. Imla ka usool: «اِبْن» aur «اِبْنَة» ka hamza us waqt hazf ho jata hai jab yeh do naamon ke darmiyan aayein, jaise: «سَعْدُ بْنُ مُعاذٍ».
intro.ar: نَكْتُبُ بِخَطِّ النَّسْخِ. قاعِدَةُ الإِمْلاءِ: تُحْذَفُ هَمْزَةُ «اِبْن» وَ«اِبْنَة» إِذا وَقَعَتا بَيْنَ عَلَمَيْنِ، مِثْلُ: «سَعْدُ بْنُ مُعاذٍ».

dialogue.ar: سَعْدُ بْنُ مُعاذٍ صَحابِيٌّ كَريمٌ.
dialogue.tr: saʿdu bnu muʿādhin ṣaḥābiyyun karīm
dialogue.en: Sa'd ibn Mu'adh is a noble companion.
dialogue.ur: Saad bin Muaz ek jaleel-ul-qadr sahabi hain.

dialogue.ar: خَديجَةُ بِنْتُ خُوَيْلِدٍ زَوْجَةُ الرَّسولِ ﷺ.
dialogue.tr: khadījatu bintu khuwaylidin zawjatu r-rasūli
dialogue.en: Khadija bint Khuwaylid is the wife of the Messenger ﷺ.
dialogue.ur: Khadija bint Khuwailid Rasoolullah ﷺ ki zaujah hain.

dialogue.ar: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ عالِمٌ كَبيرٌ.
dialogue.tr: aḥmadu bnu ḥanbalin ʿālimun kabīr
dialogue.en: Ahmad ibn Hanbal is a great scholar.
dialogue.ur: Ahmad bin Hanbal ek bade aalim hain.

dialogue.ar: مَيْمونَةُ بِنْتُ الحارِثِ زَوْجَةُ الرَّسولِ ﷺ.
dialogue.tr: maymūnatu bintu l-ḥārithi zawjatu r-rasūli
dialogue.en: Maymuna bint al-Harith is the wife of the Messenger ﷺ.
dialogue.ur: Maimoona bint al-Haris Rasoolullah ﷺ ki zaujah hain.

dialogue.ar: كانَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ العَزيزِ خَليفَةً عادِلاً في حُكْمِهِ.
dialogue.tr: kāna ʿumaru bnu ʿabdi l-ʿazīzi khalīfatan ʿādilan fī ḥukmih
dialogue.en: Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz was a just caliph in his rule.
dialogue.ur: Umar bin Abdul Aziz apni hukumat mein ek adil khalifa the.

q.en: When is the hamza of «اِبْن» dropped in writing?
q.ur: «اِبْن» ka hamza kab hazf hota hai?

options: At the start of a sentence

q.ur: Kaun sa sahi likha gaya hai?

q.en: Which script is used for the calligraphy practice?
q.ur: Khushkhati ke liye kaun sa khat hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ خَطٍّ نَسْتَعْمِلُهُ في تَدْريبِ الخَطِّ هُنا؟

q.en: In «زَيْدُ بْنُ ثابِتٍ», which word is the written form of «ابْن» between two names?
q.ur: «زَيْدُ بْنُ ثابِتٍ» mein do naamon ke darmiyan «ابْن» ka likha hua roop kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: في «زَيْدُ بْنُ ثابِتٍ»، أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ هِيَ صورَةُ «ابْن» المَكْتوبَةُ بَيْنَ عَلَمَيْنِ؟

intro.en: A review for units 5 and 6: reading comprehension, listening, plurals (singular, dual, plural), matching words that go together, and correcting spelling mistakes.
intro.ur: Unit 5 aur 6 ki dohrai: parhna, sunna, wahid, musanna aur jama, saath aane wale alfaaz ka milaan aur imla ki ghaltiyan theek karna.
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ لِلْوَحْدَتَيْنِ الخامِسَةِ وَالسّادِسَةِ: فَهْمُ المَقْروءِ وَالمَسْموعِ، وَالمُفْرَدُ وَالمُثَنّى وَالجَمْعُ، وَمُطابَقَةُ الكَلِماتِ، وَتَصْحيحُ الأَخْطاءِ الإِمْلائِيَّةِ.

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني عَدَمَ وُجودِ فُرْصَةِ عَمَلٍ؟
